name: Jewish Quarter of Třebíč
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: The Jewish Quarter of Třebíč (Czech: Židovská čtvrť v Třebíči) is a neighborhood and former ghetto in the town of Třebíč, located in western Moravia, Czech Republic.
